summary: babysit --act auto-resolves outdated unresolved review threads; keep gh-plate --json stdout clean for e2e (#605).
migration_impact: Agents running gh plate pr babysit --act after addressing feedback no longer need a separate resolve pass for outdated threads.
migration_guidance: 1. Prefer babysit --act after pushes that address review lines.
2. Still resolve non-outdated threads explicitly after applying suggestions.
agent_notes: Outdated+unresolved threads resolve on act=True. Non-outdated still need plate_resolve_review_thread.
